name: eduplay
description: Root development commands for the EduPlay platform and games

scripts.setup: npm run setup:deps && npm run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names platform,games,editor "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:games" "npm run dev:editor"
scripts.build: npm run build:games && npm run build:platform
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=edu-play-core run lint && npm --prefix phaser-projects run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=edu-play-core && npm run build --workspace=@edu-play/phaser-ui --workspace=@edu-play/game-core --workspace=@edu-play/ai-content
scripts.test: npm run test:unit --workspace=edu-play-core && npm run test:games
scripts.test:e2e: npm --workspace=edu-play-core run test:e2e && npm --prefix phaser-projects run test:e2e
scripts.verify:agent: npm run verify:agent --workspace=edu-play-core && npm run test:games
scripts.test:games: npm --prefix phaser-projects run test:validation && npm --prefix phaser-projects run test:game-core && npm --prefix phaser-projects run test:config-validation
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && npm run db:seed
